reconstructed_captions.36: A multi-pronged stitching chisel is placed on the edge of the leather.
reconstructed_captions.37: A mallet strikes the chisel, punching a row of stitching holes into the leather.
reconstructed_captions.38: The chisel is repositioned to continue punching holes along the leather's edge.
reconstructed_captions.39: A close-up shows the line of evenly spaced stitching holes on the black leather.
reconstructed_captions.40: A hand positions a circular hole punch tool over the leather.
reconstructed_captions.41: A mallet strikes the punch tool, creating a clean, circular hole for a snap.
reconstructed_captions.42: A hand inserts the post of a metal snap fastener through the newly created hole.
reconstructed_captions.43: The corresponding cap of the snap is placed on the other side, over the post.
reconstructed_captions.44: A setting tool is placed on top of the snap cap, ready to be hammered.
